description: This file defines the APIService class, which abstracts HTTP requests to a backend server. It handles GET and POST requests, authentication tokens, URL construction using environment variables, and response parsing with error handling.

classes.name: APIService
classes.description: A class that provides methods for making HTTP GET and POST requests to a backend API, supporting authentication and configurable base URL via environment variables.

methods.name: APIService
methods.description: Constructor for APIService, allows setting an optional authentication token.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Updates or sets the authentication token used in request headers.

methods.name: _baseUrl
methods.description: Retrieves and validates the API base URL from environment variables.

methods.name: _headers
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers, including Authorization if token is present.

methods.name: _uri
methods.description: Constructs a Uri object from a path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with JSON encoded body and parses the response.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request with optional query parameters and parses the response.

methods.name: _parseResponse
methods.description: Parses the HTTP response, throws exceptions on errors, returns decoded JSON.
